ticket.title: Evaluate reqwest 0.13 and tower-http 0.7 adoption and aws-lc-sys build overhead
ticket.description: Evaluated 2026-10-28: reqwest 0.13.5 and tower-http 0.7.1 are available (sawhorse/benchwork/rabbet pin reqwest 0.12; joiner/benchwork/rabbet pin tower-http 0.6). Adoption is gated on measuring aws-lc-sys build overhead against the current rustls-tls feature set before switching.

task.title: Evaluate reqwest 0.13 and tower-http 0.7 adoption and aws-lc-sys build overhead
task.description: reqwest 0.13 introduces rustls with aws-lc-rs/aws-lc-sys by default, requiring cmake and adding significant build time on clean checkouts. Benchmark ring vs native-tls vs aws-lc-rs before moving across sawhorse, benchwork, and rabbet.
